invariants.rationale: Result is the value returned by postWrite, which should not be null to indicate successful processing.
Input records should not be null, as precondition checks or framework contracts likely ensure a non-null argument.
instantTime is used to identify operations and should be a non-empty string.
userDefinedBulkInsertPartitioner is always populated (can be Option.empty()), but the Option object itself should not be null.
If there is any WriteStatus produced, there must have been input records to write.
